Name: Farmer and the Sea
Author: YourPeachiness
Description: Farmer and the Sea A small underwater adventure for Stardew Valley. Dive in, catch what lives down there, and set off fireworks underwater. Requires: Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, Content Patcher 2.9+ Install: put the folders FarmerAndSea and [CP] Farmer and the Sea into your Mods folder. How to start: 1. Sleep once. Next morning Willy sends a letter with a net and a firework. 2. Buy the Oxygen Hood from Willy (200g) and wear it in your hat slot. 3. Walk into the water on the right side of the beach. 4. Swim up to the top to come back. In the water: - Lightning jellyfish shock you on contact. Catch them with the net. - Sea fish and squid, speared with the broken trident. Squid ink the screen. - Lobster, crab and shrimp, crawling on the sand. Use the net. - Sea urchins and giant clams, which may hold pearls. - Lucky fireworks, outdoors or underwater. Settings: most numbers can be changed in config.json. Restart the game after. This mod only adds its own items, map and textures, and works in English and Chinese.

Downloads.Description: 1.0.6: Fixed shared player state wiped every frame (SVE swim pose, Ginger Island boat freeze, log spam); oxygen hood no longer drawn twice; no longer dragged underwater right after surfacing.
